title: Stochastic Simulation for Bayesian Modeling in Psychology
text:
Welcome
This website will hold the online version of Stochastic Simulation for Bayesian Modeling in Psychology: An Introduction to Computational Methods. No version of the book has been released yet.
The chapters are written and published in the development version of this website as they become ready. Once a set of chapters is complete, it is released here as a numbered version, and every released version remains available through the version menu in the sidebar.
